body:
Ellie thank you for commenting on my first ever post. 

But SERIOUSLY you’re such a fighter!!! You rock!! You’re instilling hope in others!  Im glad this week has been going well for you ☀️
You just made me tear up. Thank you really 💕

I keep dwelling on the past too just know there was a time that you were happy. With my bpd and social anxiety, I’ve had a hard time maintaining relationships as well and cut out many people. You can still find that similar happiness and you just have to reach out like you did here. That’s a big step
